reasons: A line is the plainest reading of a value over an ordered axis.
An area gives one series the weight of its magnitude.
Steps show a value that holds until it changes.
Several value columns overlay or stack as waves.
A cyclic axis (hours, months, degrees) closes the line around a circle.

notes: The rows are the `rows` prop: plain objects, one per datum, read through the accessor props.
